options.name: agentport
options.description: UDP port used for SNMP discovery.

options.name: community
options.description: SNMP community used for device discovery. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: device
options.description: IP address of the device. If a hostname is given, it is resolved to the IP address.

options.name: landscape
options.description: Landscape handle of the SpectroServer to which add or remove the device.

options.name: state
options.description: On V(present) creates the device when it does not exist. On V(absent) removes the device when it exists.

options.name: url
options.description: HTTP, HTTPS URL of the Oneclick server in the form V((http|https\)://host.domain[:port]).

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If V(false), it does not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
